item.text: The diagnosis holds: the stream reader never records deltas, and the current usage value is attached to response types. I’m moving usage into a separate per-call result and counting the cumulative streamed text as it arrives, so chunk boundaries do not change the tokenizer total.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "printf '%s\\n' 'Verified: plan discards streamed deltas for usage, and usage is embedded in response types. Implementing separate counters and cumulative stream tokenization.' >> .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md"
